svg.text: Follow a light with an open hand.
点中，那一位行动者响一声。
Meet it, and that actant sounds once.
左右移，换一层。松开，停在这一页。
Move sideways to change the page.
这一下织进正在织的布里。
That press is woven into the cloth.
Your own path, woven into the cloth.
扫码保存。再踩踏板，回到编织页面。
Scan to keep it. Step the treadle
again to return to the loom.
